name: Image sequence import
notes: Bundle asserts the whole PNG sequence appears in asset_references inputs (not just frame 1) and the emit step is an image output. render confirms the sequence uploads and the import comp output lands. The emit comp writes a TIFF sequence (AE ships no PNG Sequence output-module template -- RENDER_FINDINGS.md #11); the *imported* footage is still PNG, since that is pre-generated source material and unaffected. Until 2026-10-01 the emit comp rendered H.264 to a .png filename, so the emit half produced no sequence at all.
